I. STATE WING — PRINCIPAL FLOOR PLAN

g.text: FOUNTAIN COURT · to the back wing, unroofed since Amarantha ↑
↓ to the Guest Wing, terraced gardens and the Tide Stair · Plate IV

svg.text: II. KEY TO THE STATE WING

g.text: Tarquin's throne on a three-step dais
Vault stair — opens to the High Lord's palm
Presentation mark before the low dais
Cupbearers' pass — wine comes this way
Guest of honour's chair & cupbearer's post
Tide-steps — the lowest wets at spring tide
canon = from the books · ⚑ = devised for this table

svg.text: Lemon tree in gilt shell urn

g.text: ◆ The processional axis. Landing platform, sea-glass doors, vestibule, fifty
metres of carpet to the dais. Everyone in the hall watches a guest walk it.
◆ Two halls, two registers. The Throne Hall is for the whole court. The Lesser Hall
is where Tarquin does his real business, with stewards and a dozen courtiers,
and where an attendant is presented.
◆ The council chamber. One door from the throne hall, one to the colonnade.
With the four sea-wards raised nothing said at the chart-table carries past the
◆ Dark corners. The Tapestry Passage runs the full depth of the wing between
hall and banquet, six pillar niches behind the hangings and no lamps. The
exedrae of both colonnades hide a seated pair from the walk.
◆ The cupbearer's road. Buttery, banquet hall, arcade, terrace: seventy metres
carried in full view, and a post at the right elbow of the guest of honour.
◆ The view. The high table and the dining room both face the mouth of the bay —
green and cobalt and midnight. Nothing on the terrace is hidden from the hall
◆ Ways out. South colonnade to the gardens and the Tide Stair; north colonnade
toward the cliff causeway and the villa.
